preflight_correction: Before any size/timing result: published W2 entity IDs are 1..255; Num strings preserve digit-only strings, not decimal punctuation. Original draft retained separately. No corpus or result existed when corrected.
scope: Released W2-v1 serialization of already structured supported ASTs; no model, no training, no free-text compression claim
baselines: compact UTF-8 named-field JSON without null/default optional fields
schema-specific positional JSON with the same W2 enums/LEX dictionary and trailing defaults omitted
adaptive dense/sparse JSON with shared defaults and no redundant nested type tags
per-message raw/zlib1/zlib9/gzip1/gzip9 adaptation for both W2 and all JSON baselines, with a one-byte codec selector
whole-corpus and fixed 128-record batches compressed for both representations

primary_hypotheses.H_semantic_payload: At least 20% fewer total framed application bytes for W2 adaptive compression than strongest declared JSON adaptive compression across all eight semantic families
primary_hypotheses.H_verbal_payload: At least 20% fewer total framed application bytes for W2 adaptive compression than strongest declared JSON adaptive compression across all four verbal families

correctness_gate: 100% equality across every dataclass field for original AST, W2 decoded AST and all JSON decoded ASTs; canonical roundtrip; no dropped/failed records
framing: Each independently transferred message has the same four-byte length prefix. Adaptive compression adds one byte for its codec selector. No HTTP/TLS/IP overhead claimed measured.

timing.claim_gate: No latency superiority claim from size; actual native codec timings reported separately; validation work is not identical

controls: Defaults for required enums are first enum values; optional defaults follow published dataclasses. Numeric required defaults are zero except entity IDs use their lowest valid value 1; open strings default empty.
Schemas and code hashes are frozen before main size/timing measurement. A change requires a separately versioned run.
Every family and seed is reported, including losses. Balanced synthetic coverage is not a production workload sample.
A pass establishes a bounded engineering payload advantage over these JSON encodings, not unique superiority over all binary formats or model accuracy.
Batched/stream compression results are reported even if they remove or reverse the independent-message advantage.
No paid inference, no GPU, no published SDK/source/protocol changes. Existing private historical artifacts remain immutable.
